correctness.rationale: The explicit support function yields the maximum cross-part distance. Any two edges with gaps above a fixed threshold are joined by an extreme-endpoint bridge, hence the far-distance graph has one nontrivial component. The exact monochromatic-component probability follows by finite binomial counting. The consecutive-size difference has sign binom(p,s-1)-binom(q-1,s-1)<=0. An almost-sure positive interval with a single far edge yields strict positive-moment inequalities using tail integration. The finite checker tested exact conditional probabilities and strictness instances; it is not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This is a strict all-dimensions stochastic order for the full Euclidean width distribution of a natural family of nonnested root polytopes, not a restatement of the facet/Ehrhart data. It identifies a unique balanced maximizer and a star minimizer simultaneously for every positive moment, with a new deterministic threshold-component mechanism of mathematical interest.
